guard: a frozen working seat is distinguishable from a progressing one; heartbeat freshness is not progress
why: A cell that only asserts working for a working seat PASSES AGAINST THE BUG: a frozen seat
also self-reports working. The discriminating cells are frozen-vs-progressing labels and
the control that a heartbeat can be fresh while last-assistant age is stale.
A1 treats missing observation as fresh progress, restoring the guess.
A2 uses presence heartbeat age as the work observation, the measured lie.

mutations.name: A1 missing observation is treated as fresh progress
mutations.find: if (observation === undefined) return { kind: "unknown", label: "progress unknown" };
mutations.expectRed: no observation is progress unknown, not a guessed stall

mutations.name: A2 stall threshold never fires, so a 25m freeze looks fresh
mutations.find: if (ageMs > stallMs) return { kind: "stalled", label: `stalled ${ageLabel(ageMs)}`, ageMs };
mutations.replace: if (false && ageMs > stallMs) return { kind: "stalled", label: `stalled ${ageLabel(ageMs)}`, ageMs };
mutations.expectRed: a frozen working seat is stalled, not attested working
